text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Uhyaaaagh! What the?! Whoa, whoa, whoa—what was that?

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: H-huh? I feel kinda… hot. Like I'm overflowing with power…

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: YEEEAAH! I'm gonna dash all the way back to the dorms!
